runs.hypothesis: Short-term reversal after abnormally high-volume days in small-cap stocks

factors.name: Volatility Gap
factors.explanation: Measures the spread between top and bottom volume quantiles over 20 days, ranking stocks based on extreme volume dispersion

factors.name: Volume Residual
factors.explanation: Captures volume deviations from a time trend, highlighting abnormal volume patterns that may signal impending reversals

factors.name: Momentum Shift
factors.explanation: Weights recent return momentum by volume volatility, emphasizing stocks with divergent price and volume dynamics

factors.name: Volume Asymmetry
factors.explanation: Identifies stocks where extreme volume occurs at different times within a 10-day window, capturing asymmetric liquidity shifts

factors.name: Volume Dispersion
factors.explanation: Normalizes volume variability relative to its standard deviation, highlighting stocks with unusually volatile trading activity

factors.name: Volume Lagged Impact
factors.explanation: Combines lagged volume normalization with recent return changes, capturing delayed market reactions to volume spikes
